in_english.meaning: Name of Germanic origin meaning “prosperous” or “wealthy”.
in_english.long_meaning: Name of Germanic origin meaning “prosperous” or “wealthy”, derived from the Old High German words “ahal” meaning “prosperity” and “si” meaning “wealth”. In Christian tradition, Aloise is associated with the virtues of prosperity and abundance, and is often given to children born into families of means. In modern usage, the name Aloise has become popular in various Christian cultures, symbolizing hope and prosperity for the child.
